title: boundaries/README.md counted dev-edge list omits sc-decision-schema
description: Same class as ARCH-001 and ARCH-002. The 'Dev-dependency and self edges' section says r-3b's workspace-tests takes the 'counted' branch with sc-agent-types, sc-jev-check and sc-jev-host adding workspace-tests to allowed_dependents. It gives no r-7 note that sc-decision-schema is now a fourth counted dev edge. The wording is attributed to r-3b, so it is historically accurate. But the section is live guidance and now disagrees with the ADR-SAG-0028 r-7 amendment (docs/architecture.md:1580-1589) and with boundaries/sc-decision-schema/decision-schema.toml:21.
